title: Latency Probe: Per-Route & Per-Model Investigator UI and Chart Kit
creator: Sana Patel
description: Design and prototype a compact Investigator panel for the Redwood Console that surfaces per-model and per-route performance signals (latency, throughput, token breakdowns) with quick comparison and root-cause hints. Primary users: engineers, SREs, and platform PMs. Goals: rapid triage (<90s) for regressions, clear rollout impact visualization, and actionable handoff to traces or runtime configs. Key features: percentile ribbons and microtrace swimlanes; token-flow waterfall with KV-cache overlays; cost-per-1k-token sparklines and per-route unit economics; rollout impact overlay to compare canary vs baseline; compact defaults with on-demand expansion for details.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype with responsive panels (desktop) linked and approved by PM and Eng
Three chart specs documented (percentile ribbon, token waterfall, throughput heatmap) with axis, aggregation, and sampling guidance
Interaction design for rollouts overlay (compare two time ranges/model variants) with clear state transitions
Accessible color palette and patterns for up to 4 concurrent variants with contrast checks
Hand-off tokens: component specs, CSS tokens, and example React story for each panel
design_notes: Prioritize compactness: default panel height <= 420px to allow stack with logs and cost tiles
Provide logarithmic y-axis option for latency when tails exceed 1s to surface both median and tail
Toggle between per-request and per-token cost views; default to per-1000-token unit for billing clarity
Show KV cache hint markers when upstream cache miss rate > 5% and expose click-to-trace
Microtrace preview should link out to Observability > Traces with same time alignment and filters
chart_specs: Percentile Ribbon (latency): X=time (1m-24h), Y=latency ms; show p50/p90/p95/p99 ribbons; sampling: min 10k requests or 1hr window; tooltip: percentile, sample count, warmup flag

Token Waterfall (token-level): X=token position, Y=avg processing ms; stacked by substage: decode->embed->attn->kv->generate; overlays: prefix cache marker (boolean), token-cost-per-op; render fallback: aggregate into buckets of 50 tokens for long responses
Throughput Heatmap (route): X=time bucket 1m, Y=throughput rps; cell intensity = tail latency p95; supports zoom to 1s buckets for micro-inspection; thresholds: SLO, soft-warning, critical
Cost Sparklines: compact sparkline per-route of cost-per-1000-tokens with 7d and 30d toggles; annotate sudden jumps >20% with editable hypothesis tag and link to related PRs/dashboards
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Ribbons chosen over boxplots for a cleaner, denser visual language and easier percentile-over-time comparison
Default downsampling to 10k requests for client render performance — tradeoff: very rare outliers may be omitted from the dashboard but will remain available in raw traces
Avoided embedding full span waterfall in main panel to reduce cognitive load; provide microtrace link for full span waterfall
Rollout overlays limited to comparing two variants concurrently to keep visuals interpretable and performant

notes_for_engineers: Server API: provide percentile time-series (p50/p90/p95/p99) per route/model with consistent bucket alignment. Prefer 1m aggregation for dashboard and 10s for microtrace endpoints.
Include KV cache metadata per-request to enable cache overlay markers and simple hit/miss rate buckets.
Frontend: use canvas-based rendering for token-waterfall to handle large token counts in edge cases; provide a server-side aggregated fallback to buckets of 50 tokens for rendering performance.
Telemetry team: expose cost-per-1000-token computed field and variant-tagged metrics for rollout overlays
